note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = dial centre. Plan sizes from the trace (42 mm case width, listing); heights estimated for the listed 12.9 mm before the house depth scale (no side view). Dial, four subdials, flange print and the gasket ring come from one photo map with all hands removed; hands, applied time-subdial batons, bezel, pushers and crown are 3D.

case.note: round body; brushed sloped top between the bezel and the case edge

dial.note: flat dial to the flange, then the printed flange as a cone up to the bezel edge

lug.note: shoulders: a straight edge from the case to the lug corner (fitted to the silhouette; the pushers hide it below 14.75 mm)

bracelet.note: House curl (SUR419P1): bend at the lug tips (23.75 mm), 7 mm radius, end_y = tip + 2.2 x radius. Three columns: outer links from the lug tips, centre links 1.9 mm further out (photo)

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass. Black base colour keeps the dark dial clear (SRPG18J1)

steel_brushed.note: ambientCG Metal009 (CC0) NormalGL 1K; lines run along the bracelet; bevels keep the plain polished material
